about: Critic (C3c): on foot at the wreck, straight across the river road both ways by real input: east to the river (the rail at d -9.6, plan.js RIVER.rail) and west into the facades; where the eye stops (d in the road's frame). FAILS today if the eye ends past the rail, over the water. NOIR_PORT=5343 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/critic/c3c_wreck_rail.json --size 1440x900

steps.eval: (async () => { const P = await import('/src/stages/city/plan.js'); const e = G.controller.pos; const s = P.riverSAtZ(e.z); const F = P.riverFrame(s, {}); const d = (e.x - F.x) * F.rx + (e.z - F.z) * F.rz; return JSON.stringify({ eye: [+e.x.toFixed(2), +e.y.toFixed(2), +e.z.toFixed(2)], s: +s.toFixed(1), d: +d.toFixed(2), rail: P.RIVER.rail, quay: P.RIVER.quay, hw: P.RIVER.hw, pe: P.RIVER.pe, pw: P.RIVER.pw, pitch: +G.controller.pitch.toFixed(2) }); })()

steps.name: east, to the river: across the rail?

steps.walk: (async () => { const P = await import('/src/stages/city/plan.js'); const e = G.controller.pos; const s = P.riverSAtZ(e.z) - 4; const out = []; for (const k of [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1]) { const p = P.riverPoint(s, -24 * k); out.push([p.x, p.z]); } return out; })()
